text:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — starting intake for Nimbus-15b bring-up. Need perf/quant/quality triage before we open canary.
Igor Sokolov: +1. Quick ask: primary goals? throughput for streaming, p95 latency under 120ms for 1k ctx, and maintain qual within +/-2% on instr evals.
Jamie Chen: Added perf checklist to the intake doc: batch sweep, ctx sweep (1k/2k/4k), cold-start warmup, quant int8/int4 candidates. Link: https://redwood.internal/s/INTAKE-714
Sarah Ng: Do we have a suggested priority? My vote: 1) int8 smoke (latency/cost), 2) batch profile, 3) ctx long tail, 4) quality/regression evals.
Maya Patel: That works. Also flagging customers using 8k contexts — need to confirm fallback policies.
Igor Sokolov: Bench plan: run throughput @ batch sizes [1,2,4,8,16] for seq_len 512/1024, and ctx sweep at effective sequence lengths 1024/2048/4096. Use 10k tokens steady-state.
BenchBot: Scheduled run: Nimbus-15b fp16 baseline -> job #B-8245 started by Igor at 2024-06-12T09:10Z
Jamie Chen: Reminder: use KV-cache warmup for cold start tests: run 50 requests with varied prefixes.
Maya Patel: QA: add instruction-following evals and a couple production prompt templates. If quality drops >2% on instruction-f1, hold canary.
Sarah Ng: Quant notes — try both per-channel symmetric and asymmetric quant for int8; int4 via GPTQ path. Measure output tokenization drift.
Igor Sokolov: Quick log from fp16 run: throughput@batch8 seq512 = 190 tokens/sec, p95 latency = 85ms. Append full CSV to intake.
BenchBot: Job B-8245 completed. Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/nimbus15b/fp16/B-8245/results.csv
Jamie Chen: FP16 looks fine. Next: int8-ldq run. Assigning to @Igor.
Igor Sokolov: Starting int8 run now. Command:
```
./bench --model nimbus-15b --quant int8 --batch 8 --seq 512 --tokens 10000 --out results/int8-b8-512.csv
```
BenchBot: Job B-8246 queued.
Maya Patel: Also schedule a small quality check run on the int8 outputs: eval harness on instr-eval-v2, 2k prompts.
Sarah Ng: I'll take quality triage. If instr-f1 drops >1.5% vs fp16, annotate diffs and run targeted reruns with per-channel symmetric.
BenchBot: Job B-8246 completed. int8 throughput@b8 seq512 = 280 tokens/sec, p95 = 105ms. Artifacts: s3://.../int8/B-8246
Jamie Chen: Nice throughput gain, latency a bit higher but still within SLO. Need to see cost delta and quality numbers.
BenchBot: Quality check B-8247 (int8 instr-eval) completed. instr-f1 delta = -1.1% vs fp16.
Sarah Ng: That's acceptable per threshold. Flagging a few failure cases — will paste representative diffs in the intake doc.
Maya Patel: Next: long context sweep. Goal to measure p95 and mem scaling at 1k/2k/4k.
Igor Sokolov: Heads up: at 4k seq, batch1 p95 jumps to ~260ms and memory grows 1.9x. Need fallback policy if we hit region limits.
Jamie Chen: For rollout: propose canary with 10% traffic on Dedicated pool, with auto-fallback to fp16 variant if latency >200ms for 30s window or error rate >0.5%.
Maya Patel: Checklist before canary:
- [ ] Upload quant artifacts and CSVs to intake
- [ ] Perf summary (throughput, p95/p99, mem)
- [ ] Quality evals (instr-f1, regen rate)
- [ ] Canary config + rollback triggers
- [ ] Security review sign-off
- [ ] Customer impact matrix
Sarah Ng: I can handle quality evals and customer-impact notes. Jamie can you draft canary policy in Console?
Jamie Chen: On it. Will create canary config: nimbus-15b:int8-canary v1 -> 10% -> 7 days -> metrics-based rollback.
Igor Sokolov: After canary, plan a dedicated capacity smoke test at 100% synthetic load for 10m to validate autoscaling rules.
Maya Patel: Good. Who's owning final sign-off?
Jamie Chen: I'll own final rollout sign-off after canary passes perf + qual.
Maya Patel: Perfect. I'll open ticket INT-714 with the checklist and owners. Anyone else?
Sarah Ng: Add note: run regen consistency checks for few-shot prompts too.
BenchBot: Ticket INT-714 created: https://redwood.internal/t/INT-714
deploy-bot: Canary deployment job D-3321 created for Nimbus-15b:int8-canary by Jamie Chen
Maya Patel: Thanks team — will update the intake doc with links to artifacts and next steps. Marking this thread closed unless issues pop up. :white_check_mark:
